content: The above equation not only applies to forward hidden state $\overrightarrow{\mathbf {h}}_{i}$ and backward hidden state $\overleftarrow{\mathbf {h}}_{i}$ , but also to the concatenation $\overleftrightarrow{\mathbf {h}}_{i}= [\overrightarrow{\mathbf {h}}_{i}, \overleftarrow{\mathbf {h}}_{i}]$ and summation $\mathbf {h}^{+}_{i}= \overrightarrow{\mathbf {h}}_{i} + \overleftarrow{\mathbf {h}}_{i}$ , resulting in a tensor $\mathbf {D}^{13 \times |sent1| \times |sent2|}$ after padding one extra bias term. A “hard” attention is applied to the interaction tensor to build word alignment: selecting the most related word pairs and increasing the corresponding weights by 10 times. Then a 19-layer deep CNN is applied to aggregate the word interaction features for final classification.
